'''July 2000 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Broken Games, Lake City Way, Seattle, WA on 15 July 2000. [[Douglas Harvilla]] won it. It is known from Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1006">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-seattle-wa-7-15-00d1006/ seattle-wa-7-15-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-seattle-wa-7-15-00d1006/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Broken Games, Lake City Way, Seattle, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Douglas Harvilla]]
